result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred position: automatic 12-month renewals, Customer can opt out on 30 days’ written notice, Vendor must provide a reminder at least 60 days before renewal, and increases remain capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%. However, changing the Vendor’s non-renewal notice period from 180 days to 30 days is not necessary to give Customer the required opt-out right and gives Vendor materially greater termination flexibility. The language is otherwise clear and professionally drafted, and Section 8.3 is appropriately unchanged.
